sources.name: Dogwoof
sources.blurb: The premier international documentary specialist: distributing, financing and selling titles like Free Solo and The Cave.

sources.name: Magnolia Pictures
sources.blurb: Major indie distributor behind prominent theatrical docs including RBG, Blackfish and Food, Inc.

sources.name: Kino Lorber
sources.blurb: Art-house distributor with a deep non-fiction catalogue, including Fire at Sea and classic film restorations.

sources.name: NEON
sources.blurb: High-profile theatrical distributor known for prestige, festival-favourite docs such as Flee, All the Beauty and the Bloodshed and Moonage Daydream.

sources.name: Oscilloscope Laboratories
sources.blurb: Independent distributor founded by Adam Yauch, releasing eclectic films like Exit Through the Gift Shop.

sources.name: Greenwich Entertainment
sources.blurb: Boutique company focusing on culture, music and social issues (The Booksellers, Echo in the Canyon).

sources.name: Icarus Films
sources.blurb: Focuses on social, political and historical documentaries from international filmmakers.

sources.name: Sideshow / Janus Films
sources.blurb: Art-house partners handling theatrical releases for major festival docs like EO and All the Beauty and the Bloodshed.

sources.name: First Run Features
sources.blurb: One of America's oldest indie distributors, specialising in human rights, LGBTQ+ and social justice topics.

sources.name: Cinema Guild
sources.blurb: Distributes festival-driven, international and avant-garde non-fiction films.

sources.name: HBO Documentary Films
sources.blurb: Industry giant funding and distributing prestige non-fiction like The Jinx, Going Clear and Welcome to Chechnya.

sources.name: PBS (POV & Independent Lens)
sources.blurb: The primary US public broadcasting home for independent non-fiction filmmaking.

sources.name: CNN Films
sources.blurb: Acquisition and co-production arm behind commercial hits like Navalny, Apollo 11 and Blackfish.

sources.name: ESPN Films / 30 for 30
sources.blurb: Premier producer and distributor of sports and cultural documentaries (O.J.: Made in America).

sources.name: National Geographic Documentary Films
sources.blurb: Focuses on science, nature and high-stakes human endurance (Free Solo, Fire of Love, Sugarcane).

sources.name: BBC Storyville
sources.blurb: The BBC's flagship international documentary strand, commissioning world non-fiction cinema.

sources.name: ARTE
sources.blurb: European public service channel that heavily co-produces and distributes creative documentaries worldwide.

sources.name: Netflix
sources.blurb: Global leader in true crime, feature-length docs and limited series (13th, My Octopus Teacher, The Elephant Whisperers).

sources.name: Apple Original Films
sources.blurb: Focuses on high-budget prestige non-fiction like Boys State and Still: A Michael J. Fox Movie.

sources.name: MUBI
sources.blurb: Curated global platform acquiring festival, foreign and experimental non-fiction.

sources.name: Hulu / Onyx Collective
sources.blurb: Focuses on culture, music and investigative docuseries.

sources.name: Cinephil
sources.blurb: Premier sales agency specialising in international festival docs like Collective and Gunda.

sources.name: Submarine Entertainment
sources.blurb: Major sales agent and production company representing Oscar winners like Summer of Soul and Citizen K.

sources.name: Autlook Filmsales
sources.blurb: Global sales boutique for festival-driven docs like The Painter and the Thief.

sources.name: Deckert Distribution
sources.blurb: Specialises in creative documentaries with a strong focus on Central and Eastern Europe.

releases.title: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
releases.overview: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

releases.title: Windows on the World: 9/11's Forgotten Story
releases.overview: Twenty-five years after 9/11, this gripping documentary tells the untold story of the 170 people trapped inside Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant on the top floors of the World Trade Center’s North Tower.

releases.title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
releases.overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

releases.title: Achill Island
releases.overview: Life on Achill Island, off County Mayo – shark fishing, shepherding, pottery making, teaching, B&B-ing and socialising in the pub by night.

releases.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
releases.overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

releases.title: SUMO: Spirit Weighs Nothing
releases.overview: SUMO: Spirit Weighs Nothing grants rare inside access to Japan’s notoriously private world of sumo. Over a turbulent year of sacrifice and survival, wrestlers at different stages of their career fight to endure within one of Japan’s most punishing traditions. Behind the curtain, true strength is measured — not in flesh, but in refining the spirit.

releases.title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
releases.overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

releases.title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
releases.originalTitle: Fito Páez: El mundo cabe en una canción
releases.overview: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

releases.title: Celtic Utopia
releases.overview: The story of a new Ireland and its vibrant music scene, but also that of a postcolonial society wrestling with its heritage. A society where folk music carries both the oppression of the past and the dream of a bright future.

releases.title: Super Nature
releases.overview: We’re invited on a journey across 25 different countries, with people embracing both abundance and loss, to feel a sense of togetherness with our fellow dwellers on earth, human and non-human. Celebrating all we have and reflecting on all we have to lose, Super Nature proposes a new way of seeing.

releases.title: Fragments of Paradise
releases.overview: For over 70 years, Jonas Mekas, internationally known as the "godfather" of avant-garde cinema, documented his life in what came to be known as his diary films. From his arrival in New York City as a displaced person in 1949 to his death in 2019, he chronicled the trauma and loss of exile while pioneering institutions to support the growth of independent film in the United States. Fragments of Paradise is an intimate look at his life and work constructed from thousands of hours of his own video and film diaries-including never-before-seen tapes and unpublished audio recordings. It is a story about finding beauty amidst profound loss, and a man who tried to make sense of it all... with a camera.

releases.title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
releases.overview: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.

releases.title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
releases.overview: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

releases.title: Teenage Wasteland
releases.overview: Inspired by an unconventional teacher, a group of teenagers in upstate New York in the early 1990s make a student film and uncover a vast conspiracy that is poisoning their community. Thirty years later, they revisit their film and confront the legacy of this transformative experience.

releases.title: Nobody Here: The Story of Vaporwave
releases.overview: ‘Nobody Here’ traces the story of Vaporwave and its evolution into the internet’s most aesthetic and celebrated micro-genre — from its origins in obscure online communities to its emergence in the mainstream consciousness.

releases.title: The Club That Conquered the Premier League
releases.overview: The story of the local neighbourhood club, Antiguoko, that became a Basque dream team and helped produce Premier League managers Xabi Alonso, Mikel Arteta and Andoni Iraola.

releases.title: Remake
releases.overview: For nearly forty years, Ross McElwee has made autobiographical documentaries about how his personal life intersects with the wider world. After his son Adrian died of a fentanyl overdose in 2016, McElwee abandoned a planned Hollywood dramatic remake of his own 1986 breakthrough film Sherman's March, and instead used decades of home-movie footage — including Adrian's own camera work — to reckon with his son's life, his addiction, and what the camera did and did not capture.

releases.title: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
releases.overview: A decade after O.J. Simpson was controversially acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman, he attempted to rebrand himself as a reality TV star with the hidden camera prank PPV special Juiced.

releases.title: Lomu
releases.overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

releases.title: The Bodies on the Bridge
releases.overview: In July 2024, the discovery of the two suitcases containing human remains on Bristol’s Clifton Suspension Bridge shocked the nation and sparked one of the UK’s most disturbing murder investigations in recent memory.

releases.title: Filling the void
releases.overview: A portrait of Magali Garçon, a professor at the Cherbourg School of Arts, whose convictions, feminist vision, and committed personality challenge the traditional art academy, bringing a unique and transformative perspective to her teaching.

releases.title: They're Here
releases.overview: Edén Villa (pseudonym) and anonymous Minneapolis residents evade and resist the paramilitary occupation of their city, in a winter landscape where masked agents abduct children, residents travel in trunks, shackled prisoners are loaded onto airplanes within eyesight of vacationers, and bicyclists track the movements of an invading force.

releases.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
releases.overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

releases.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
releases.overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

releases.title: A Killer Story
releases.overview: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

releases.title: Secrets of the Bayeux Tapestry: Inside the Museum
releases.overview: The Bayeux Tapestry is one of the treasures of the medieval world. Across 70 metres of exquisitely embroidered scenes, it tells the story of one of the most seismic events in British history – the Norman Invasion of 1066.  For the last 950 years, this crucial part of Britain's national story has remained on the other side of the English Channel, in Bayeux, Normandy, but now it’s coming back to the UK.  A stellar cast of historians and experts follow the painstaking efforts to bring this priceless work of art back to the UK, where experts believe it was made, for a once-in-a-millennium exhibition at the British Museum.

releases.title: The Pandemic Prophet
releases.originalTitle: Professeur Raoult vs le gang des Cerises
releases.overview: When Professor Didier Raoult promotes a "miracle cure" for COVID-19, six ordinary citizens go after the truth -- including his own daughter.

releases.title: Pompeji - Die Villa von Neros Kaiserin
Andy Goldsworthy in Conversation with Andrew Graham-Dixon
releases.overview: Filmed entirely on-site at the National Galleries of Scotland during Goldsworthy's monumental 2025 retrospective, Andy Goldsworthy: 50 Years, this compelling film captures an exclusive, deeply personal dialogue between the world-renowned land artist and the acclaimed art historian, author, and broadcaster.  The documentary offers an unprecedented look behind the scenes of Goldsworthy’s largest and most ambitious indoor exhibition. Surrounded by new installations created specifically for the show, the pair explore the core environmental philosophies, fleeting natural materials, and creative ideas that have defined the artist's extraordinary half-century career.

releases.title: Dragging Up The Past
releases.overview: Cork’s long association with drag and its history is celebrated in Dragging Up The Past, a documentary utilising a mix of archival footage and interviews to showcase Cork City’s colourful drag community.

releases.title: Steel: The Blood of Us
releases.overview: Steel: The Blood of Us is a cinematic love letter to the end of the industrial revolution, capturing the community of Port Talbot, Wales, in the final years of traditional steelmaking. Through raw, poetic storytelling and evocatively shot on 16mm film it weaves together the voices of generations to celebrate a way of life on the brink of vanishing.

releases.title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
releases.overview: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity, and explores the most powerful technology humanity has ever created... and what's at stake if we get it wrong.

releases.title: James McNeill Whistler
releases.overview: Tate Britain is now holding the first major retrospective of Whistler in three decades. This blockbuster exhibition promises to reawaken the world to just how important Whistler is to art history, uniting world-famous masterpieces with rarely seen works. Exhibition on Screen will bring these stunning works and the incredible story behind them to cinemas around the world while the exhibition is still running, bringing this truly global artist to a global audience. This will be an unmissable chance to get to know this visually spectacular artist and the influence he has had on those who followed.

releases.title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
releases.originalTitle: Liberté, la statue qui voulait changer le monde
releases.overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.

releases.title: Everything Happens All the Time
releases.overview: Through twenty-seven interviews, street footage, and photographs, this film explores the relationship between street photographers, their practice, and one another in the community that has formed around the genre in London.

releases.title: JAŸ-Z in 8
releases.overview: Thirty years after his landmark debut album, artist, icon, philanthropist, and entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career.

releases.title: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
releases.overview: A young officer is killed inside a general's home. The investigation that followed revealed a cover-up at the highest ranks of the National Police.

releases.title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
releases.overview: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail. Executive produced by Judd Apatow.

releases.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
releases.overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

releases.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces: First Home
releases.overview: Britain is in the grip of a housing crisis, with many people unable to afford a traditional bricks-and-mortar home. George and his long-time collaborator Will Hardie meet the proactive and determined people finding creative ways to create a place they can call home. From buses and boats to former toilet blocks and tiny homes, the series follows couples and families transforming unexpected spaces into affordable homes of their own.

releases.title: The Cycle of Love
releases.overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

releases.title: The Watergate Caper: Richard Nixon and the Death of the American Dream
releases.overview: The Watergate Caper is an archival documentary, narrated by Harry Shearer (This is Spinal Tap), tracing the rise and fall of Nixon from the presidential primaries of 1968 through the Watergate break-in of June 1972 to his resignation two years later, killing trust in the political process and the American presidency in the wake of the Vietnam War.  The film draws on hundreds of hours of TV news taped off-air by the Nixon White House to tell the untold story of the Watergate burglars. How did tapping the wrong phone with a bug that didn't work lead to their arrests and Nixon's resignation?  It also explores representations of the Nixon years in popular culture, using the music, commercials, and cinema of the era to evoke a fevered political landscape of culture wars, dirty tricks, paranoia and assassination.

releases.title: Falco Mon Amour
releases.overview: Falco is the only German-language singer to reach number one in the US billboard chart. This documentary looks back at the life and work of the 1980s Austrian cultural phenomenon who took the world by storm with hits like "Rock Me Amadeus", "Vienna Calling" and "Der Kommissar". With contributions from his last girlfriend, Caroline Perron.

releases.title: The Com: Online, Sadistic and Deadly.
releases.overview: Parents are being warned of the dangers of ‘The Com’ or ‘764’, a sadistic online network that targets often vulnerable young people, destroying their lives. Sky's Adele Robinson reports using testimony from survivors, parents, law enforcement investigators and journalists, as they try to understand this new global grooming terror.

releases.title: Schloss Schönbrunn - Hinter der Fassade der Macht
Dead Wife Cult
releases.overview: The life of cult icon Zoë Lund, through the eyes of her widower and an avid fan.

releases.title: English Ultraviolence
releases.overview: Heavy Weekend 01: Underground “no rules” fight clubs are spreading fast across Europe, organised in secret and hidden from the authorities. No tickets, no spectators, no public locations. This isn’t bare-knuckle boxing. Eye-gouging, biting, stamping, head-butts and choking are all allowed. It’s not sport—it’s organised ultraviolence.  Hanrahan attends one of the UK’s first no-rules fight clubs to find out why young men are risking it all on the concrete.

releases.title: Yeah Yeah Yeahs: Hidden in Pieces
releases.overview: Indie-rock group the Yeah Yeah Yeahs channel the spirit of David Lynch with this exquisitely ethereal, sublimely surreal record of a Los Angeles concert performance.

releases.title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
releases.overview: Shelley Beattie, a Deaf woman and champion bodybuilder, found fame in the 1990s on the hit TV show American Gladiators, where she competed under the name "Siren" before her untimely death in 2008. While charismatic, gorgeous, and a fierce competitor, Beattie also battled personal demons, struggling with mental illness, addiction, and questions of her own identity. Framed by the insight of another Deaf woman in Hollywood who found herself in the spotlight at the same time, Academy Award-winning actress Marlee Matlin, the documentary unpacks the story of Shelley "Siren" Beattie and her complex legacy entwined with beauty, mental illness, and love.

releases.title: Boundless: The Man Who Became Human
releases.overview: Ben Greenfield taught millions how to master the body. This is the story of everything that mastery could not reach. What remains when a man can no longer outrun himself?

releases.title: Boorman and the Devil
releases.overview: Featuring commentary from surviving participants, as well as other filmmakers and critics, this documentary chronicles the career of director John Boorman and the tumultuous production of his film Exorcist II: The Heretic, exploring its critical and commercial failure, how it changed the industry, and the importance of risk-taking in art.

releases.title: The Hammer
releases.overview: Simon de Pury is a familiar face in the art world. The former chairman of Sotheby’s has a larger-than-life personality and is known as the «Mick Jagger of auctions.»

releases.title: Out of Breath
releases.overview: OUT OF BREATH shines the spotlight on the human cost paid by people living with sleep apnea and their loved ones. Yet, for all the darkness they face there is also light at the end of the tunnel as their hope, courage, and perseverance brings them closer to the promise of successful treatment.

releases.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
releases.overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

releases.title: The Last First: Winter K2
releases.overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

releases.title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
releases.overview: In 2022, Salman Rushdie was preparing to deliver a lecture on the United States as a safe haven for writers when a man rushed the stage and, in 27 seconds, stabbed him 15 times. Airlifted to hospital, Rushdie survived, barely, and his wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths began filming immediately, capturing an unfiltered view of his recovery, return to life and how he regained his spirit and hope for the future.

releases.title: Secrets of the Southwest
releases.overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

releases.title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
releases.overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

releases.title: Try!
releases.overview: Four Irish Rugby teams who defy stereotypes tackle their way to the Mixed Ability Rugby World Cup, where full-contact sport meets joyful belonging.

releases.title: Travel Reminiscence
releases.overview: At a London community centre, facilitators and volunteers run a travel-themed session for people living with dementia and their families, friends and carers.  Together, the group embarks on a playful journey: discussing past trips, revisiting these through theatre, and writing postcards to loved ones.

releases.title: The Dance of the Kokorrdit
releases.overview: A Wounaan teenager and a leader of their community venture into the Darién in search of a sacred bird. Along the way, they will face the dangers that threaten their territory and their culture.

releases.title: Lesbian Lines
releases.overview: In a silenced Ireland, a community of lesbians builds an underground network of helplines - offering connection, survival, and defiance through the simple act of answering the phone.

releases.title: André Leon Talley — Style is Forever
releases.overview: André Leon Talley was a trailblazing fashion icon whose influence spanned nearly five decades. This documentary explores his legacy of inclusivity, elegance, and the fearless pursuit of authenticity. Interviews with Anna Wintour, Tom Ford and Diane von Furstenberg, among others, as well as never-before-seen footage, reveal Talley’s personal and professional challenges and remarkable triumphs.

releases.title: Everest: The Other Side
releases.overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest - the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth - something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

releases.title: Transformation
releases.overview: A feature-length documentary exploring the profound inner metamorphosis of Ukrainian civilians from the creative sector who chose to enlist as soldiers to defend their country. The film maps the deep psychological and lifestyle shifts experienced by musicians, artists, and filmmakers as they stepped away from civilian art to enter the realities of war.

releases.title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
releases.overview: Serving as an intimate and cinematic portrait of Sagan, the Untitled Carl Sagan Documentary will explore his love story with partner Ann Druyan and with science. The film will include exclusive audio recordings, archival clips and animation, along with interviews with his family, friends and colleagues. With the full support of Sagan’s family and friends, the film will present a fascinating look into the life and career of one of the world’s most inspiring and revolutionizing scientists of our time.

releases.title: Duckweed
releases.overview: Obscure, aging, and living on the outskirts of London, writer of supernatural fiction Quentin Crisp asks himself a fundamental existential question: ‘Who am I?' This feature-length film-essay is structured around readings of Crisp’s own zuihitsu of the same name, which, in essence, is the story of his life. As we follow Crisp on a walk deeper into the ‘‘little wood’’ of his private landscape, the binaries of success and failure begin to fade away.

releases.title: Forza on the Run
releases.overview: Heavy Weekend 02: The French police have put the illegal drift racers of Paris on final notice, so they've took off on the run across the border into Belgium. Hanrahan rides along with the crew as they dodge police and takeover Brussels.

releases.title: Enter the Television
releases.overview: From Tom Seymour creator of the VHS Massacre Trilogy. Enter the Television is a feature-length documentary exploring the dark corners of television from obscure commercials to unconventional cable programming. It examines the evolution of media through an underground lens, revealing how independent voices survive within systems controlled by powerful media corporations.

releases.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
releases.overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

releases.title: Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down
releases.overview: "Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down" is a documentary film about British social policy. The focus is on the political struggle against neoliberal austerity policies, which have their origins in the hated Thatcher government.  The film features the former socialist MP Dave Nellist, who is now the national chair of the Trade Unionist & Socialist Coalition and Hannah Sell, the general secretary of the Socialist Party. The film features a local election campaign in the miners' town of Nuneaton, students campaigning against an increase in tuition fees and refuse workers from Birmingham striking against massive cuts to their wages.

releases.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
releases.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

releases.title: Making Marie Antoinette
releases.overview: Eleanor Coppola's behind-the-scenes documentation of her daughter Sofia Coppola directing the 2006 film Marie Antoinette, capturing the craftsmanship and challenges of being a young female director.

releases.title: Finding Faith
releases.overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith Tour via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

otherDates.note: Precedes screenings of George Michael: The Faith Tour

releases.title: Whiddy
releases.overview: A small rural community in Ireland welcomes in a major, global oil company with open arms but just 10 years and numerous oil spills later, that dream turns into an unimaginable nightmare. 50 lives lost in a tragedy that silenced and divided the community and still haunts it to this day.

releases.title: 1 in 2
releases.overview: Nearly one in two of us will be diagnosed with cancer at some point in our lives. David Nicholas Wilkinson is one of them, twice over. In 2020, a colonoscopy found his bowel to be extremely healthy for a man his age. In 2023, a FIT test came back clear and, like almost everyone who takes one, he assumed that meant the all-clear. In 2024, a second colonoscopy found bowel cancer. Stage 4. He was told his tumour was 5-6 years old. What went wrong? A FIT test looks for blood. Wilkinson’s tumour never bled. Nor do a great many others.  1 IN 2 follows Wilkinson through his own treatment, where he discovers a steep rise in bowel cancer among people far too young to be screened for it, and far too young, it seems, to be believed. Among those who tell him their stories is a bowel surgeon whose own symptoms were dismissed by her oncologist colleagues and in part by herself because she was only 44.

releases.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing
releases.overview: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew

releases.title: American Doctor
releases.overview: When three heroic American doctors — Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian — enter Gaza to save lives in the middle of a genocide, they find themselves caught between medicine and politics, risking everything to expose the truth.

releases.title: Phantom 814
releases.overview: Heavy Weekend 03: Unique access to the most mysterious organisation in France. Jake Hanrahan travels with the bizarre syndicate known as "814SSR". They shoot guns, host fight clubs, and make money in the underground. Yet still, they insist they're not a gang and are simply doing hardcore trolling. The truth? Decide for yourself...
